description.value: Sazón is a traditional Mexican restaurant in the heart of Kitsilano, just a short walk from Kits Beach on the popular West 4th Avenue cycling corridor. Dishes are prepared by cooks from Mexico using recipes passed down through generations, with ingredients imported from Mexico when needed. The restaurant offers a warm family atmosphere with both dine-in and online ordering for pickup and delivery.
